Mission status changes caused by a run are embedded in the run journal entry (payload.mission {missionId, from, to, reason}) instead of a separate MISSION_TRANSITIONED entry, so the run step and the mission move are one atomic append; both write and replay check them with core/mission/state-machine.ts.

Mission path used: AUTHORIZED -> PLANNED at run creation, PLANNED -> EXECUTING at IMPLEMENT, -> VERIFYING after IMPLEMENT, -> REVIEWING after VERIFY, -> REGRESSION after a CLEAN review, -> REPORTING after the regression test run. The REGRESSION step re-runs the test command in a fresh clone of the reviewed commit.

Without an executor configuration POST /v1/missions/:id/runs returns 409 EXECUTOR_NOT_CONFIGURED. The FAKE adapter can only be injected programmatically (buildServer executors option / MissionRunner); no env value selects it. UASCO_WORKOS_EXECUTOR=local-claude selects LOCAL_CLAUDE; any other value is refused.

LOCAL_CLAUDE implement reuses scripts/claude-builder-broker.mjs unchanged. LOCAL_CLAUDE review re-checks provider provenance like the broker (final PASS, launcher sha256) and runs the captured launcher with Read,Grep,Glob only, because the broker applies the builder tool policy. Neither path is executed in this package.

Read-only review is enforced by detection: after review the clean clone must still be at the reviewed commit with an empty 'git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all', otherwise the run is BLOCKED (REVIEWER_MUTATED_CLONE).

testCommand is an optional argv field on project and mission (mission overrides project). Only 'node' is resolved to process.execPath; other allow-listed executables are spawned by name with shell:false, so Windows .cmd shims (npm, npx, pnpm, yarn) are not spawnable and give BLOCKED TEST_COMMAND_SPAWN_FAILED. A missing test command gives BLOCKED TEST_COMMAND_NOT_CONFIGURED.
The engine reads the run queue across tenants through engine-only methods (engineListRuns/engineGetRun); API routes use tenant-scoped reads only.
Lease heartbeats are RUN_LEASE RENEW journal entries (every leaseTtlMs/3, default TTL 120 s) and are also written between steps.

GLOBAL_STOP is checked before each step, between steps, and polled every 250 ms during child processes; an active stop kills the child process tree (taskkill /T on Windows) and the run goes CANCELLING -> CANCELLED with the mission BLOCKED.
Secret scan covers private keys, AWS, GitHub, Anthropic and OpenAI-like tokens on added diff lines only; hits record kind/file/line, never the value, and logs are redacted with the same patterns.
